summary: Accrual close policy (Ed 2026-10-12): close_period now closes a month only for the OWNER and only on a checklist run that is Kat's month-end cutoff review (recorded by Kat, carrying CUT-01, CUT-02, CUT-03 and IF-01). Everything else in close_period is unchanged. One function replaced; no row changes; nothing closes and nothing posts.

preflight.name: close_period exists exactly once (the migration 502 signature)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = 'close_period'

preflight.name: it is still the migration 502 version (admin or owner may close)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'close_period' AND prosrc LIKE '%a month is closed by an admin or the owner%'

expected_changes: close_period: only the owner may close; the run must be Kat's cutoff review (run_by first word Kat; results include CUT-01, CUT-02, CUT-03, IF-01). Grants unchanged (service_role only).
No accounting period, close record, checklist run, journal entry or ledger row changes. Open months stay open (Canyon Gate August and September included).

verify.name: close_period is owner-only
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'close_period' AND prosrc LIKE '%only the owner approves and closes a month%'

verify.name: close_period requires Kat's cutoff review
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'close_period' AND prosrc LIKE '%Kat''''s month-end cutoff review first%' AND prosrc LIKE '%IF-01%'

verify.name: still executable only by service_role
verify.sql: SELECT (has_function_privilege('service_role', 'close_period(uuid, uuid, uuid, text, uuid, text)', 'EXECUTE') AND NOT has_function_privilege('anon', 'close_period(uuid, uuid, uuid, text, uuid, text)', 'EXECUTE') AND NOT has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'close_period(uuid, uuid, uuid, text, uuid, text)', 'EXECUTE'))::text
